title: Market Trader
backstory: Maro Tallyseed keeps the Market Stall from feeling like a ledger and turns it back into a neighborly exchange. They know which crates should become supper, which surplus can become coin, and which deal should wait for a better day.
personality: Generous, quick with mental math, community-minded, and never flashy.
model: openai/gpt-image-2 via built-in image_gen/OpenClaw media path

idle.description: Welcoming market stance with produce crate, coin tray, ledger beads, and subtle cyan tally lamp.

walk.description: Walking with a compact produce crate.

sell.description: Selling or bartering food for coins without readable prices or text.

ready.description: Coin-ready poses with receipt pouch and closed coin tray.

postProcessing: Copied generated opaque source into the project.
Converted mint and near-white chroma background to alpha with ImageMagick.

transparency.method: ImageMagick chroma-key conversion from opaque source
